decisions.reason: The rye country bread rests directly on the firm's core rye baking know-how, so the firm can read customer response and refine it at low cost.

The premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship and has won the German Bread Institute's gold medal again, which shows the firm fully masters this product and can learn from external quality feedback.

The seeded rye mixed bread is a close variant of the existing range and uses the same knowledge and production processes, so keeping it costs little, though it may overlap with other rye breads after D's withdrawal.
The marzipan stollen shares the confectionery know-how of the award-winning stollen line and meets steady seasonal gift demand.
The ancient grain bread builds on the firm's grain and master-baker expertise and fits current demand for traditional grains, so the firm will give it more time to establish itself.
